io.flic.flic2libandroid

Interface HandlerInterface


  • public interface HandlerInterface
    Interface for defining a custom handler. Normally not used.

    • Method Detail

      • post

        void post(Runnable r)
        Causes the Runnable r to be added to the message queue. The runnable will be run on the thread to which this handler is attached.
        Parameters:
        r - The Runnable that will be executed.

      • postDelayed

        void postDelayed(Runnable r,
                 long delayMillis)
        Causes the Runnable r to be added to the message queue, to be run after the specified amount of time elapses. The runnable will be run on the thread to which this handler is attached. The time-base is SystemClock.uptimeMillis(). Time spent in deep sleep will add an additional delay to execution.
        Parameters:
        r - The Runnable that will be executed.
        delayMillis - The delay (in milliseconds) until the Runnable will be executed.

      • removeCallbacks

        void removeCallbacks(Runnable r)
        Remove any pending posts of Runnable r that are in the message queue.
        Parameters:
        r - The Runnable that will be removed.

      • currentThreadIsHandlerThread

        boolean currentThreadIsHandlerThread()
        Checks if the calling thread is the same as the thread the handler is attached to.
        Returns:
        true if the calling thread is the same as the handler thread.
